notes: The EasyCard works on the MRT, buses and YouBike; eating and drinking are banned on the MRT (fines apply). It takes 40 minutes by MRT to Taoyuan Airport.
October to December is the best season (22-26°C). January and February are 12-15°C and rainy, but it is hot spring season. Shops are closed over Chinese New Year.
Night markets are open 18:00-24:00; 300 TWD is enough to eat your fill. No tipping, and cash is still common.
For Jiufen, Shifen and Yehliu take a tour (~1,500 TWD) or the 1062 bus; go to Jiufen in the afternoon, as the lanterns light up after 17:00.
Take a queue number at Din Tai Fung; in Yongkang, Lin Dong Fang noodles cost 250 TWD.
Shoes are not taken off in temples; divination blocks and incense are allowed.

transit.name: EasyCard
transit.why_chosen: Works on the MRT, buses, YouBike and in shops, including the Jiufen bus.

stops.name: Taipei 101 Observatory
stops.tips: 89th floor; the first slot in the morning is uncrowded. See the wind damper ball.

stops.name: Xinyi District
stops.tips: Shopping malls and the Eslite bookshop; air-conditioned.

stops.name: Din Tai Fung Xinyi
stops.tips: The brand where xiaolongbao (soup dumplings) was born; take a queue number at 11:45.

stops.name: Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall
stops.tips: Changing of the guard every hour; park with a view of Taipei 101.

stops.name: Elephant Mountain
stops.tips: 20 minutes of steep steps; the sunset photo of Taipei 101, crowded but worth it.

backups.name: Kao Chi Yongkang
backups.tips: A cheaper rival to Din Tai Fung; xiaolongbao.

backups.name: Songshan Cultural Park
backups.tips: Design exhibitions in an old tobacco factory.

stops.name: National Palace Museum
stops.tips: Imperial Chinese treasures, including the jadeite cabbage and the meat-shaped stone. Go Tuesday to Saturday and get in before the morning tour buses arrive.

stops.name: Shilin Official Residence
stops.tips: Gardens of Chiang Kai-shek's residence; rose garden.

stops.name: Lin Dong Fang Beef Noodle
stops.tips: Taipei's best beef noodle soup (Bib Gourmand); clear broth.

stops.name: Beitou Thermal Valley
stops.tips: Steaming green thermal lake; smell of sulphur, MRT Xinbeitou.

stops.name: Beitou Public Hot Spring
stops.tips: Public hot spring (60 TWD, swimsuit required); you'll be among locals.

backups.name: Shilin Night Market
backups.tips: Taipei's biggest night market; giant fried chicken cutlet and stinky tofu.

backups.name: Beitou Hot Spring Museum
backups.tips: Japanese-era bathhouse building; go on a rainy day.

stops.name: Yehliu Geopark
stops.tips: Queen's Head rock and mushroom rocks; arrive before the morning tour buses.

stops.name: Shifen Waterfall
stops.tips: Taiwan's Niagara; 20-minute walk.

stops.name: Shifen Old Street
stops.tips: Release a wish lantern over the railway (150 TWD); watch the train pass.

stops.name: Jiufen Old Street
stops.tips: Terraced mountain town; taro balls and tea houses, with a Spirited Away feel.

stops.name: A-Mei Tea House Jiufen
stops.tips: Tea house with red lanterns; oolong and views, and the lanterns light up at sunset.

backups.name: Houtong Cat Village
backups.tips: Cat village; an alternative to Shifen.

stops.name: Longshan Temple
stops.tips: Taipei's oldest temple; morning prayers, incense and divination blocks.

stops.name: Bopiliao Historic Block
stops.tips: Qing-era street; free exhibition.

stops.name: Dihua Street
stops.tips: Dadaocheng's street of dried goods and tea; Baroque facades, Chinese New Year market.

stops.name: Yongle Market Food Court
stops.tips: Local food in the Dadaocheng market; oyster omelette.

stops.name: Dadaocheng Wharf
stops.tips: Riverside container bars; sunset and cycling.

backups.name: Ximending
backups.tips: Taipei's Shibuya; youth culture and street art, an alternative to the wharf.

stops.name: Maokong Gondola
stops.tips: Glass-bottom gondola from Zoo station; tea gardens at the top.

stops.name: Maokong Çay Evi
stops.tips: Oolong tea and tea-based dishes at the top; views of Taipei.

stops.name: Taipei Zoo
stops.tips: Pandas; gondola station.

stops.name: Zhinan Temple
stops.tips: Taoist temple on the mountain; gondola middle station.

stops.name: Raohe Night Market
stops.tips: Single-street night market; at the entrance, charcoal-baked pepper buns (Fuzhou pepper bun).

backups.name: Bitan Scenic Area
backups.tips: Lake and suspension bridge in Xindian; boats.

stops.name: Tamsui Old Street
stops.tips: End of the MRT line; estuary town, a-gei (stuffed tofu) and fish balls.

stops.name: Fort San Domingo
stops.tips: Dutch-Spanish fort and British consulate; red building.

stops.name: Tamsui A-Gei Lokantası
stops.tips: Glass noodles inside tofu; Tamsui's signature dish.

stops.name: Fisherman's Wharf Tamsui
stops.tips: Lovers' Bridge; reached by ferry, pier cafés.

stops.name: Tamsui Gün Batımı Sahili
stops.tips: One of Taiwan's most famous sunsets; river mouth.

backups.name: Bali Left Bank
backups.tips: Ferry to the opposite bank; cycle path.

stops.name: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall
stops.tips: Giant white monument and changing of the guard (every hour); Liberty Square.

stops.name: Yongkang Street
stops.tips: Cafés and mango shaved ice; Smoothie House.

stops.name: Yongkang Beef Noodle
stops.tips: Beef noodles with seared beef since 1963; farewell lunch.

stops.name: Da'an Forest Park
stops.tips: City forest; last walk. 40 minutes by MRT to Taoyuan Airport.

backups.name: Smoothie House Yongkang
backups.tips: Mango snow ice; a dessert instead of noodles.

backups.name: Taipei Botanical Garden
backups.tips: Lotus ponds; an alternative to the park.
